requirement: The desktop update host serves Windows and Linux feeds, signatures and installers, records each install's platform and each browser download per OS, while a Mac app gets the same answers as before

oracle.invariant: S1: stable.yml (win), dev-linux.yml and dev-linux-arm64.yml (linux) stream with no-store and record the install with platform win / linux and the x-arch header. S1: <channel file>.sig for the four channel-file names streams with no-store as application/octet-stream and records nothing. S1: .exe, .AppImage and .deb, flat or under <channel>/<version>/<build id>/, stream with their IANA content types and no-store; a GET writes no desktop_install row. S1: .blockmap, latest.yml, latest-mac.yml, stable-win.yml, stable-linux-armv7l.yml, a .sig of anything but a channel file, a channel file or manifest.json inside a release folder, .msi, .rpm and lowercase .appimage answer 404 without asking the store. S1: stable-mac.yml, flat and foldered zip and dmg answer the same status, body and headers as before; the mac read records platform mac; the two dmg GETs record two downloads. S1: migration 086 files a desktop_install row written before it as mac and refuses a platform outside mac/win/linux; /ops/desktop/installs has an OS column (macOS / Windows / Linux + version) and no macOS column; App Statistic installs report macos / windows / linux. S1: a browser GET of Tracy-Cowork-<v>-win-<arch>-setup.exe, -linux-<arch>.AppImage or .deb writes a desktop_download row with platform windows/linux, arch, channel, version and utm source; the same GET carrying App-Name or App-Version (the app's updater) writes nothing and sets no cookie; dmg metadata is unchanged. S1: App Statistic filters downloads, installs and users by platform=macos|windows|linux, lists the platforms in options, and refuses any other value.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
